title: Semester and Detention
author: Wren Eriksen
blurb: Zephyrine Sandoval, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
